title: Merge write-guard-precision's unmerged content into the bundle
action: A compounding triage found write-guard-precision is the only queued promote proposal with content the bundle does not already state; the other six were closed as already-stated. Its proposal has an empty area-sync section only because the work item declared no bee.areas — an authoring gap, not an absence of content. Merge the three behavioral claims, verified LIVE at HEAD: (a) the secret-prefix and scratch-prefix write guards exempt paths whose extension marks them as source code (guards.rs CODE_FILE_EXTENSIONS, is_secret_path, scratch_shape_deny) — precision over blanket strictness, so ordinary source work is not refused by a guard aimed at secrets and scratch files; (b) the idle-gate git allowlist admits a table of safe forms — bare branch, tag, remote, stash list/show, worktree list, reflog, grep — so inspection is never blocked while tree-rewriting verbs stay refused (checks.rs evaluate_git_invocation); (c) a refusal caused by an unresolvable worker count names its own remedy rather than failing opaquely (checks.rs WorkerCount::Unresolved). Ask the CLI for the write target and frontmatter (bee knowledge check, bee knowledge context, bee knowledge promote if a new concept is warranted) rather than assuming the file named in this cell is right — if guard precision belongs in its own concept under hook-runtime, promote one and record the deviation. Cite decision write-guard-precision D1 and the wgp-1/wgp-2 cells as sources. Do NOT merge the proposal's two pattern candidates: both restate a skipped-reservation deviation and are feature narration, failing all three promotion bars.

truths: Each merged claim traces to the live code or to decision write-guard-precision D1
Guard precision is readable as behavior — a stranger with only the spec knows which paths a guard exempts and why
The two narration-only pattern candidates are not promoted
The CLI named the write target; any deviation from this cell's declared file is recorded

trace.outcome: Merged write-guard-precision's three guard-precision claims into a new hook-runtime concept (guard-precision-exemptions-and-remedies.md), flushed the queued capture stub, left the two narration-only pattern candidates unmerged
